slides.title:
Meet Hybi at Hybrid Physio!
Book via the link in bio

caption:
Koko loves photographing birds, but after every shoot one shoulder feels tight and knotted.

A heavy bag on one shoulder keeps that side, and the neck, working all day. Remedial massage can help ease that tight feeling, and it works well alongside staying active and changing how you carry your gear.

Hybi's routine: use both backpack straps, pack only the lenses you need, and roll your shoulders back 10 times every hour.

Arm tingling, pain at night, or tightness lasting more than two weeks is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 📷

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
